senses.gloss:
एध् एध् (a form of अर्ध्, the original form of ऋध्), i. 1, Ātm. (in epic poetry also Par., MBh. 3, 15031).
 1. To prosper, MBh. 2, 510.
 2. To increase, Rām. 2, 52, 34; to grow up, Śāk. d. 51.
 --Caus. एधय.
 1. To cause to prosper, Bhāg. P. 7, 1, 11.
 2. To glorify, Kumāras. 6, 90.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To increase, Bhāg. P. 5, 11, 17.
 --With सम् सम्, To increase, Bhāg. P. 3, 21, 25.
 समेधित,
 1. Strengthened, MBh. 3, 10443.
 2. United, Rām. 2, 64, 35.
 --Caus. To cause to prosper, MBh. 13, 7510.
